go-live • Work closely with the wider Flyt team in Norway and
Denmark • Help shape how Flyt works in Germany — methodology,

background, technical or functional — on Odoo, SAP, Dynamics or

knowledge, with practical ERP experience • At least two years of
management consulting experience, or other consultancy, with a genuine
appetite to build deep Odoo expertise Alongside that, you bring: • A
master's degree in a relevant field, or equivalent professional
experience • A consulting mindset — ready to act as lead
consultant, with strong communication skills in front of clients •
The ability and curiosity to learn a lot, fast – ready to take on

processes, with attention to details • Fluent German and English,
preferably experience with English as company language • A
willingness to travel, and an appreciation for working together in
person — based in or near Hamburg is a plus, not a requirement What

enthusiastic, knowledgeable consultants who support each other. • A
culture of knowledge sharing and collaboration. You'll work alongside
Flyt colleagues, and knowledge and experience is shared between
Germany, Norway and Denmark. • A flat structure across three
countries — short decision paths, and your ideas reach the people

methodology to the colleagues we hire next • Varied, end-to-end work
on Odoo. You'll take on projects across industries and full business
processes • 30 days of annual leave • An office in central
Hamburg, at Hohe Bleichen in the Neustadt district • Regular
exchange and team events with colleagues in Norway and Denmark •
Company laptop and mobile phone, in addition to other relevant

We are the European general agency of the globally active shipping company KAWASAKI KISEN KAISHA Ltd. ("K" Line). As a leading shipping company in the RoRo business, we offer highly sophisti­cated and tailor-made mari­time trans­port solu­tions to our custo­mers from the automotive and heavy machinery indus­tries. As European headquarters based in Hamburg, we are respon­sible for plan­ning and managing the regular services from Europe to North America and Asia as well as their marke­ting in Europe.

Your responsibilities

- Support technical assessment and acceptance of cargoes incl. High & Heavy, special and project cargo as well as review of operational handling
- Support IMDG-related coordination, including documentation review, DG stowage information and operational communication with vessels and ports.
- Participate in cargo quality follow-up, damage prevention, port attendance, vessel feedback and survey-related matters.
- Support QCM/VOS team with analysis of operational deviations, near misses, cargo damage cases and root-cause identification incl. standardization of workflows, SOPs, checklists and digital tools.
- Assist with claims handling by reviewing damage documentation, survey reports, incident reports and operational evidence.
- Prepare and issue voyage instructions, discharging instructions, sailing information and operational updates in internal systems.
- Communicate with vessels, ship management companies, local offices, ports, agents and internal departments to maintain scheduled voyages.
- Support bunkering coordination, including confirmation of fuel specifications and review of bunker supplier information.
- Prepare, review and distribute cargo stowage plans to relevant parties.
- Collect and follow up operational cost reports from local offices.
- Assist with environmental and technical matters related to vessel operations.
- Support operational follow-up in case of disruption, delay, off-hire or other vessel-related incidents.
- Prepare summaries, meeting materials, reports incl. incident reports in case of accidents, serious cargo damage or operational irregularities and coordinate required follow-up actions.

Your profile

- Completed vocational training, university degree or comparable qualification related to shipping, logistics, nautical science, marine operations or port operations.
- Nautical background, sea-going experience, port captain experience or marine technical experience is an advantage.
- Professional experience in RoRo shipping, vessel operations, port logistics, cargo planning, High & Heavy, survey or claims handling is desirable.
- Good understanding of vessel operations, port processes, cargo flow, stowage planning and international communication chains.
- Knowledge of the IMO CSS Code, IMDG Code and SOLAS is an advantage.
- Very good written and spoken English; German language skills are expressly preferred.
- Careful working style, strong affinity for numbers, good prioritization skills and a sense of responsibility in critical situations.
- Willingness to travel to European ports, terminals, vessels and service providers as well as a Class B driving license.

Digital competencies

- Confident use of Microsoft 365, especially Outlook, Excel, Word, PowerPoint, Teams and SharePoint.
- Experience working with structured data, operational reports, Excel analyses and management documents.
- Openness towards digital collaboration tools such as SharePoint Lists, Planner, Loop or comparable solutions.
- Basic understanding and responsible use of modern AI models and AI-supported applications in the daily work context.

- Cross-departmental role between Vessel Operations and Quality Control & Marine Technical with a diverse range of responsibilities
- Close collaboration with international colleagues, ports, vessels, OEMs, surveyors, and ship management teams worldwide

In this role, you will be responsible for delivering high quality flight training for gyroplane pilots in both practical and theoretical environments. You will work in accordance with applicable German and international aviation regulations as well as internal standards and contribute to maintaining and developing our global training quality.

The position combines hands on flight instruction with close collaboration across engineering, sales and after sales functions. You will operate in an international environment and represent AutoGyro towards customers and partners in a professional aviation context.

The activity is based on site at our location in Hildesheim, with occasional international assignments.

The role can alternatively be structured as a cooperation with self employed flight instructors (m/f/d) or flight schools. This includes the delivery of training under the AutoGyro framework and alignment with defined standards and procedures.

Become part of our dynamic team and actively contribute to the success of our company. You can expect attractive conditions as well as free lunch every day.

Tasks

- Delivery of flight training for gyroplane pilots in both practical and theoretical environments
- Instruction and supervision of students in accordance with applicable German and international aviation regulations and internal standards
- Execution of check flights, proficiency checks and refresher training
- Customer handover flights and aircraft familiarisation
- Assessment of student performance and documentation of training progress
- Contribution to the continuous development of training concepts and standards in line with international requirements
- Close coordination with engineering, sales and after sales in relation to aircraft and customer requirements
- Representation of AutoGyro towards customers and partners in a professional aviation context

Requirements

- Valid Flight Instructor qualification for gyroplane or a comparable instructor licence with willingness to convert
- Proven flight experience, ideally within ultralight or gyroplane aviation
- Strong instructional capability with a structured and safety oriented approach
- Sound understanding of aviation regulations and operational procedures
- High level of responsibility, reliability and professional judgement
- Confident communication skills in English and German
- Willingness to travel occasionally, including international assignments

Benefits

- Dynamic working environment with the global leader in gyroplane manufacturing.
- Comprehensive onboarding and continuous training opportunities.
- Supportive and international team culture.
- Flexible working hours (flexitime) to support work–life balance.
- Corporate fitness programme (Hansefit).
- Employer contributions to the pension scheme.
- Employee discounts via our corporate benefits platform.
- Regular company events that strengthen team spirit.
- Free daily lunch at our headquarter.
- Overtime compensation and additional paid leave for special occasions.
